title: BLS Labor Statistics Scraper Input
description: Configure which BLS data series to fetch

seriesIds.title: Series IDs
seriesIds.description: List of BLS series IDs to fetch. E.g. CUUR0000SA0 (CPI), LNS14000000 (unemployment rate), CES0000000001 (total nonfarm payroll)

registrationKey.title: BLS Registration Key (Optional)
registrationKey.description: Optional BLS API registration key for higher rate limits. Without a key, daily limit is 25 queries. Register free at https://data.bls.gov/registrationEngine/

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of data points to return per series
